screen.jem_atmosphere.settings.enabled.t: Use JEM wind, fog, mist, sky and other atmosphere effects without terrain lighting or shadows.
screen.jem_atmosphere.settings.fog.toolt: Show scene-depth-aware distance fog and biome haze.
screen.jem_atmosphere.settings.sky_color: Apply biome and weather colors to the sky and compatible clouds.
screen.jem_atmosphere.settings.aurora.to: Show auroras in cold biomes at night.
screen.jem_atmosphere.settings.rainbow.t: Show a fading rainbow after rain.
screen.jem_atmosphere.settings.distant_l: Show cool atmospheric flashes in distant storm clouds.
screen.jem_atmosphere.settings.wind.tool: Show outdoor trails that follow the wind.
screen.jem_atmosphere.settings.river_mis: Show low mist above rivers and other bodies of water.
screen.jem_atmosphere.settings.snow_gust: Show drifting snow near the ground.
Show dust suspended in cave air.
screen.jem_atmosphere.settings.heat_shim: Show hot-air distortion outdoors and near heat sources.
screen.jem_atmosphere.settings.underwate: Show biome-colored underwater haze and subtle refraction.
screen.jem_atmosphere.settings.canopy_le: Show leaves falling from tree canopies.
screen.jem_atmosphere.settings.campfire_: Let wind bend campfire smoke into taller plumes.
screen.jem_atmosphere.settings.dark_camp: Use darker particles for campfire smoke.
screen.jem_atmosphere.settings.wind_colo: Enter biome_id=#RRGGBB. Separate entries with commas. Remove an entry to restore its default color. Red text marks an invalid edit.
